text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Good night then!
Fenomeno!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes sir! Good night, Bubble-san!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (...My debut race is almost here.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (Can I do it... just like back then?)

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "Whoa...! That scary big sister is super fast...!"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Whatcha gotta do to become like you, big sis~?
Come on~ tell me~!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "W-Wahhh...!"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Look, look! Big sis!
My hat matches yours now!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(On that day, I realized.
The way to carry out justice that only I, an Umamusume, can do.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(It is precisely because I have these legs that I can become someone to admire.
That I can serve as a "model.")

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(And if I can fulfill children's dreams
with a pure and upright example—)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (Children will grow up properly without straying from the path. And the world will become an even better place.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Alright.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Sleeping kids grow up best! Time to go to sleep, sir!!
"CASE: Initial Investigation"
—The day of the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum~♪
Hum hum huuum~♪

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief.
Talk about an overly cheerful crowd.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
This is Nakayama Festa.
The gambler Umamusume who won the Takarazuka Kinen and took on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly... Wait,
who are you talking to?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh.
Those little kids were looking at ya and went,
"Look, it's an octopus introduction!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see. Didn't expect to see your ass sitting in the audience, though.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"What did you come here for?
Who did you come to see?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hohohohoho.
Who can say?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, just watch from here on out.
Things are about to get real interestin'.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Finally, huh.
—The waiting room for the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss, take this.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Boss, I'd like you to read that page aloud
from top to bottom!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—We will now beginnnnn!
The routine inssssspectionnnnn!!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Please, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Alright!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Alright!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Checking right away!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: No problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the routine inspection!
Next up! Prepare for greetings!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: P L E A S E   T A K E   C A R E   O F   M E !

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
"Approaching the field of competition in appropriate attire and demeanor"
is part of the race entry guidelines, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
When entering the paddock,
I must also remember 'to mind my manners
and show respect to the fellow runners.'
choice_data_list: You really are the absolute picture of a role model.
You really are the very picture of a model student, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will always strive
to be a role model for the children watching the races!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
And we shall certainly show you a victory
worthy of being an inspiration to the children!
